item.description: Solid Gold Weekends are 48 hours of all CKLG Classic Hits hours on LG73! A great option for iPhone, iPad, iPod Touch and 4th gen. or 4K AppleTV is Streams Hi-fi Radio which is compatible with Apple CarPlay.
